from statemachine import State, StateMachine, DataVar

class Machine(StateMachine):
    a = State(initial=True, data={'count': DataVar(default=0, type=int), 'items': list})
    b = State()
    go = a.to(b)
    back = b.to(a)

m = Machine()
assert m.get_state_data(m.a) == {'count': 0, 'items': []}
m.set_state_data(m.a, 'count', 2)
assert m.get_data_changes()[-1].new_value == 2
m.go()
assert m.get_state_data(m.a) is None
m.back()
assert m.get_state_data(m.a)['count'] == 0
